Current Data: GLD prices jumped 2.3% following the capture of Maduro. Spot gold is currently testing the $4,450 region, with an institutional year-end target of $5,000/oz.

Why watch out? If the "Greenland Grab" leads to a fracturing of NATO or US-EU relations, GLD will likely see an exponential surge as European capital flees toward non-sovereign assets. In Malaysia, GLD (or physical gold) is your best defense against the "Ringgit Plunge" associated with South China Sea tensions.

Interestingly, oil prices are not skyrocketing as they did in previous decades. This is due to a "super-glut" in 2026—record production in the U.S., Brazil, and Guyana.
